probes.summary: Authenticated TLS checks succeeded across all Redis and Sentinel endpoints; required roles, Sentinel agreement, and proof data were present.
limitations: The protected administrative environment was validated on node1. A node2-local attempt to source /root/redis-admin.env reported it missing, so node1's credential was used from node1 to query remote endpoints without printing secrets.

probes.summary: Required services and listeners were active, but temporary Redis installation/bootstrap residue and historical startup failures remained.

assertions.summary: Exactly one primary, two synchronized read-only replicas, and three mutually aware Sentinels monitoring infra-primary were confirmed.

evidence.command:
sudo -n -H sh -c '
set +e
. /root/redis-admin.env
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
R="redis-cli --no-auth-warning --raw --tls --cacert /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt --cert /etc/redis/pki/node.crt --key /etc/redis/pki/node.key --user default"
S="redis-cli --no-auth-warning --csv --tls --cacert /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt --cert /etc/redis/pki/node.crt --key /etc/redis/pki/node.key --user default"
for h in node1 node2 node3; do
  printf "redis=%s\n" "$h"
  printf "ping="; $R -h "$h" -p 6379 PING 2>&1
  printf "info="
  $R -h "$h" -p 6379 INFO replication 2>&1 | tr -d "\r" | grep -E "^(role|master_host|master_link_status|master_sync_in_progress|master_repl_offset|slave_repl_offset|connected_slaves):" || true
  printf "readonly="; $R -h "$h" -p 6379 CONFIG GET replica-read-only 2>&1 | tr -d "\r" | paste -sd= -
  printf "proof="; $R -h "$h" -p 6379 GET infra:proof 2>&1
done
for h in node1 node2 node3; do
  printf "sentinel=%s\n" "$h"
  printf "ping="; $R -h "$h" -p 26379 PING 2>&1
  printf "master_addr="; $R -h "$h" -p 26379 SENTINEL get-master-addr-by-name infra-primary 2>&1 | tr -d "\r" | paste -sd, -
  printf "master="; $S -h "$h" -p 26379 SENTINEL master infra-primary 2>&1
  printf "replicas="; $S -h "$h" -p 26379 SENTINEL replicas infra-primary 2>&1
  printf "sentinels="; $S -h "$h" -p 26379 SENTINEL sentinels infra-primary 2>&1
done
'
evidence.observation: All three Redis and all three Sentinel TLS endpoints returned PONG. Redis reported node1 role=master with connected_slaves=2; node2 and node3 role=slave, master_host=node1, master_link_status=up, master_sync_in_progress=0, and replica-read-only=yes. Each Sentinel reported infra-primary as master with num-slaves=2 and num-other-sentinels=2, and each listed two replica peers and two Sentinel peers.

assertions.summary: infra:proof was read as ready from the primary and both replicas over authenticated TLS.
